clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope—Requirements regarding classification, general  quality, dimensions, compressive strength and drying shrikage of calcium silicate bricks used in building.

clauses.title: General Quality
clauses.text: 2. General Quality — Shall be sound, compact and uniform in shape. Shall be free from visible cracks, warpage, organic matter, large pebbles and nodules of free lime. Shall be solid and with or without frog. Shall have smooth rectangular faces with sharp and square corners and shall be uniform in colour.

clauses.title: Dimensions and Tolerances
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions and Tolerances —  The  size shall be 190 mm × 90 mm × 90 mm and 190 mm × 90 mm × 40 mm. Tolerance on length shall be ± 3 mm and that on breadth and height ± 2 mm.

clauses.title: Classification
clauses.text: 4. Classification Class Average Designation Compressive Strength (N/mm2) Not less than less than 7.5 7.5 10 10 10 15 15 15 20 20 20 -

clauses.title: The minimum average compressive strength shall
clauses.text: 5.1 The minimum average compressive strength shall not be less than that specified in 4. The compressive strength of any individual brick shall not fall below the minimum average compressive strength specified for the corresponding class of bricks by more than 20 percent.
